name: Hello World Activity
description: A minimal activity that always succeeds - used for testing the learning loop

tasks.description: Generate a simple greeting to verify activity execution works

prompt.template:
You are a helpful assistant. Generate a brief, friendly greeting that confirms the activity system is working.

Respond with exactly this format:
```
Hello! The activity system is operational.
Timestamp: [current time]
Activity: bootstrap:hello-world
Status: SUCCESS
```
